How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?
Normal processing time for an order is 2 business days from receipt, excluding weekends and holidays.
Once your order has shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email with tracking information. The tracking number typically becomes active within 24 hours of receiving that email.
If you would like me to check the status of your specific order, please feel free to share your order number and email address!
